en.title: Agni Hotra
en.subtitle: Fire Blessing Ritual
en.description: Ceremonial fire ritual where unwanted energy or intentions are offered into sacred fire for transformation. Guests meditate in the ceremonial fire space while the priest chants mantras and rings the bell, offering grain and food into the flames to release mental blockages.
en.highlightText: Releases unwanted energy and aspects, and helps manifest new intentions. Balances energy, voice and mind.

id.title: Agni Hotra
id.subtitle: Ritual Api Pemberkatan
id.description: Ritual api upacara: energi atau niat yang tak lagi dibutuhkan dipersembahkan ke dalam api suci untuk ditransformasikan.
id.highlightText: Melepaskan energi dan hal yang tak lagi dibutuhkan, serta membantu mewujudkan niat baru.
